overview.text: This fictional invention checks version numbers before accepting a data update, helping keep an older update from replacing newer information. Lantern is the team’s internal name for the checking component.

evidence.locator: Illustrative claims A1 and B1; fictional notes

technology_fit.text: The proposed bucket is cache consistency: keeping stored copies of data in agreement. The example separates technologies mapped to illustrative claims from topics mentioned only in descriptive notes. These fictional records establish no legal patent coverage.

evidence.locator: Illustrative claims A1 and B1; descriptive notes

key_findings.text: Version comparison is central to the example. A similarly worded term or related organization would need its own evidence; this demonstration includes no verified public organization research.

evidence.locator: Illustrative claim A1; fixture research scope

uncertainties.text: No real patent documents or current claim versions were reviewed. The fictional example cannot establish novelty, patentability, enforceable scope, or which companies compete in a real market.

next_steps.text: Recommended: obtain the actual documents and claim versions, confirm the intended technology buckets, and research terminology and organizations before using this structure for a real portfolio decision.
